dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr Lim. This is Rachel Koh. It is good to speak with you for our scheduled discussion. Is this still a convenient time to talk?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, office quiet now lah. Adrian Lim here. Got my account summary beside me, so no need to hunt through the files. My identification number is T three one two three one zero two L. My date of birth is 31 January 1994.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. We can keep the discussion concise. Have you been able to arrange your banking calls comfortably around the business recently?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Usually can. The warehouse team handles the dispatches now, so I don't need to stand there watching everything already. A scheduled call is easier than catching me while I'm running between meetings.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can continue arranging appointments rather than calling unexpectedly. Your objective is to free up cash for your upcoming personal commitments while reducing your exposure to bond-market fluctuations. You also mentioned wanting more time for community activities. How is that coming along?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Quite nicely lah. Helping at the neighbourhood food collection, mostly sorting things and talking to the volunteers. At work everyone asks me to decide things; over there I can just help out. Different feeling one.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a welcome change of routine. Let me turn to the investment discussion now. With Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can lower the market value of the bonds it holds, which can reduce the fund's net asset value. Do you understand how rising interest rates could reduce the value of your holding in this fund?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. Interest rates go up, the bonds it holds can drop in value, so my holding can be worth less.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction charge for this sale is 0.2%. You could lose some or all of the capital you invested in this fund. Selling below your purchase value would crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including a loss crystallised by selling this holding?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept that loss. Having the cash available for my commitments is more important to me.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Harbor SGD Bond Fund because it releases cash for your commitments and reduces your remaining exposure to interest-rate and credit-market fluctuations. For illustration only, a hypothetical sale of 10,000 Singapore dollars would release cash and reduce the remaining holding. That is an example, not your transaction amount.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Let me find the relevant page ah. Got it tucked behind the account overview. The holding I want to reduce is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding, not exit the whole position. My overall account value on this summary is 1,000,000 Singapore dollars. That's just the account total, not the amount for this sale.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for distinguishing that. I will give you a moment to check your notes before you finish setting out the details.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The printout a bit untidy lah; my handwritten notes are along the edge. Found the right bit already. For the settlement currency, use the— Use Singapore dollars for this transaction. The amount I want for this sale is 500,000. For the quantity, make it 1,500 units. Place it as a market order, please.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Can you explicitly confirm that the final transaction instruction you have just given me is what you want us to carry out?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm, let me look through my notes a bit first ah.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Of course. There is no need to rush through your notes. I will leave that question open while you review them.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The handwriting is mine, still takes me a while to read leh. Better I sit down properly with the papers instead of balancing everything next to the keyboard.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can leave the discussion here while you do that. For future appointments, would you prefer that we arrange them through a message before calling?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Message first would be useful ah. Sometimes the office looks quiet, then a supplier turns up without warning. If I can put the call in my diary, much easier to keep that space clear.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note your preference for arranging calls in advance. You can contact me when you are ready to resume the discussion; there is no need to work through the papers while attending to the office.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That suits the office routine better lah. I'll check my diary as well before getting back to you about another call. Thanks for making time today, Rachel.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You are welcome, Mr Lim. Thank you for your time, and enjoy your community activities. Goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, usually quite a lively group over there. Nice change from the warehouse lor. Goodbye.
